title: MIMIC-IV -- Diagnoses, Admissions & Demographics

grain.statement: One row per diagnosis code recorded against an admission.

caveats: Denormalised onto every diagnosis row. At row level the split is 51.6% M / 48.4% F; across patients it is 57% / 43%. Reporting the row-level figure overstates F by 5.4 points.

patient.age.description: Patient age at the anchor admission year.
caveats: Ages above 89 are recorded as 91 (de-identification cap). Treat 91 as a censored 90+ band rather than a literal age.
Denormalised onto every diagnosis row. Row-level mean is 62.71; patient-level mean is 61.75.

admissions.type.description: Route by which the patient was admitted.

caveats: MIMIC-IV shifts every date into the future by a per-patient offset. Observed range is 2110-2201. Absolute dates are meaningless and intervals are comparable only within a patient -- which this archetype cannot group by.

diagnoses.icd_code.description: Diagnosis code assigned to the admission.
caveats: Hypertension appears as 4019 (ICD-9, 1514 rows) and I10 (ICD-10, 708 rows). Matching only 4019 undercounts it by 32%.

diagnoses.icd_version.description: Which ICD revision the code belongs to.

excluded: No discharge or death date, so no length-of-stay, readmission or survival analysis.
No patient identifier, so no per-patient denominator.
No labs, vitals or medications: hosp.labevents exists in the source database but is outside this archetype.
